content: I want a rectangular box that is 220mm wide, 300mm long and 160mm high. Let it be on the upside open and have walls with 8mm thickness and a 12mm thick bottom. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the dimensions for the outer and inner blocks\\nouter_x = 220\\nouter_y = 300\\nouter_z = 160\\n\\n# Inner dimensions (subtracting wall thickness)\\ninner_x = outer_x - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides\\ninner_y = outer_y - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides\\ninner_z = outer_z - 12     # 12mm bottom\\n\\n# Base points for the outer and inner blocks\\nouter_base = (0, 0, 0)\\ninner_base = (8, 8, 12)    # 8mm walls and 12mm bottom\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"outer_x\\\": outer_x,\\n    \\\"outer_y\\\": outer_y,\\n    \\\"outer_z\\\": outer_z,\\n    \\\"inner_x\\\": inner_x,\\n    \\\"inner_y\\\": inner_y,\\n    \\\"inner_z\\\": inner_z,\\n    \\\"outer_base_x\\\": outer_base[0],\\n    \\\"outer_base_y\\\": outer_base[1],\\n    \\\"outer_base_z\\\": outer_base[2],\\n    \\\"inner_base_x\\\": inner_base[0],\\n    \\\"inner_base_y\\\": inner_base[1],\\n    \\\"inner_base_z\\\": inner_base[2]\\n}\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the outer and inner blocks
outer_x = 220
outer_y = 300
outer_z = 160

# Inner dimensions (subtracting wall thickness)
inner_x = outer_x - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides
inner_z = outer_z - 12     # 12mm bottom

# Base points for the outer and inner blocks
outer_base = (0, 0, 0)
inner_base = (8, 8, 12)    # 8mm walls and 12mm bottom

# Return the calculated values
{
    "outer_x": outer_x,
    "outer_y": outer_y,
    "outer_z": outer_z,
    "inner_x": inner_x,
    "inner_y": inner_y,
    "inner_z": inner_z,
    "outer_base_x": outer_base[0],
    "outer_base_y": outer_base[1],
    "outer_base_z": outer_base[2],
    "inner_base_x": inner_base[0],
    "inner_base_y": inner_base[1],
    "inner_base_z": inner_base[2]
}"}
